description: This PHP source file defines the MatcherDumper class in the Drupal core routing system. It handles dumping route information into a database table, including methods for adding routes, dumping route data, ensuring table existence, and schema definition. It interacts with Drupal's database, state, and logging systems, and works with Symfony routing components.

classes.name: MatcherDumper
classes.description: Handles dumping route information into a database table, managing route collection, and schema creation within Drupal's routing system.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Adds a collection of routes to the dumper, either initializing or merging with existing routes.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes route data into the database, handling transactions, table creation, and cache updates.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the current collection of routes in the dumper.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the database table exists and creates it if necessary.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the route storage table in the database.
